Require Import TLC.LibLN.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Require Import Coq.Lists.ListSet.

Require Import Lists.List.

Require Import equivalence.

Inductive Ord : typ -> Prop :=
| o_int   : Ord t_int
| o_arrow : forall t1 t2, Ord (t_arrow t1 t2)
| o_unit  : Ord t_unit
| o_prim  : forall i, Ord (t_prim i).

Definition DisjSpec PG A B := forall C, Ord C -> not (declarative_subtyping PG C (t_and A B)).

Notation "PG ||- A *s B" := (DisjSpec PG A B) (at level 80).

Module Typing_part.

Export Notations.

Inductive exp : Set :=
 | e_var_b  : nat -> exp
 | e_var_f  : var -> exp
 | e_lit    : nat -> exp
 | e_abs    : exp -> exp
 | e_app    : exp -> exp -> exp
 | e_typeof : exp -> typ -> exp -> typ -> exp -> exp
 | e_null   : exp
 | e_new    : MetatheoryAtom.Atom.atom -> exp.

Inductive bind : Set :=
 | bind_typ : typ -> bind.

Notation "x ~: T" := (x ~ T)
 (at level 23, left associativity) : env_scope.

Definition env := LibEnv.env typ.

Fixpoint open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (k:nat) (e_5:exp) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6}: exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => If (k = nat) then e_5 else (e_var_b nat)
  | (e_var_f x) => e_var_f x
  | (e_lit i5) => e_lit i5
  | (e_abs e) => e_abs (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e1) (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e2)
  | (e_typeof e A e1 B e2) => e_typeof (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec k e_5 e) A (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e1) B (open_exp_wrt_exp_rec (S k) e_5 e2)
  | (e_null) => e_null
  | e_new A  => e_new A
end.

Definition open_exp_wrt_exp e_5 e__6 := open_exp_wrt_exp_rec 0 e__6 e_5.

Notation "t 'open_ee_var' x" := (open_exp_wrt_exp t (e_var_f x)) (at level 67).

Inductive lc_exp : exp -> Prop :=
 | lc_e_var_f : forall (x:var),
     (lc_exp (e_var_f x))
 | lc_e_lit : forall i5,
     (lc_exp (e_lit i5))
 | lc_e_abs : forall (L:vars) (e:exp),
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) )  )  ->
     (lc_exp (e_abs e))
 | lc_e_app : forall (e1 e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e1) ->
     (lc_exp e2) ->
     (lc_exp (e_app e1 e2))
 | lc_e_typeof : forall (L:vars) (e:exp) (A:typ) (e1:exp) (B:typ) (e2:exp),
     (lc_exp e) ->
     ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e1 (e_var_f x) )  ) ->
     ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> lc_exp  ( open_exp_wrt_exp e2 (e_var_f x) )  ) ->
     (lc_exp (e_typeof e A e1 B e2))
 | lec_e_null :
     lc_exp e_null
 | lc_e_new : forall A,
     lc_exp (e_new A).

Fixpoint fv_exp (e_5:exp) : vars :=
  match e_5 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => \{}
  | (e_var_f x) => \{x}
  | (e_lit i5) => \{}
  | (e_abs e) => (fv_exp e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => (fv_exp e1) \u (fv_exp e2)
  | (e_typeof e A e1 B e2) => (fv_exp e) \u (fv_exp e1) \u (fv_exp e2)
  | (e_null) => \{}
  | e_new A  => \{}
end.

Fixpoint subst_exp (e_5:exp) (x5:var) (e__6:exp) {struct e__6} : exp :=
  match e__6 with
  | (e_var_b nat) => e_var_b nat
  | (e_var_f x) => (If x = x5 then e_5 else (e_var_f x))
  | (e_lit i5) => e_lit i5
  | (e_abs e) => e_abs (subst_exp e_5 x5 e)
  | (e_app e1 e2) => e_app (subst_exp e_5 x5 e1) (subst_exp e_5 x5 e2)
  | (e_typeof e A e1 B e2) => e_typeof (subst_exp e_5 x5 e) A (subst_exp e_5 x5 e1) B (subst_exp e_5 x5 e2)
  | (e_null) => e_null
  | (e_new A) => e_new A
  end.

Inductive value : exp -> Prop :=
 | val_int : forall i5,
     value (e_lit i5)
 | val_abs : forall e,
     lc_exp (e_abs e) ->
     value (e_abs e)
 | val_null :
     value e_null
 | val_new  : forall P,
     value  (e_new P).

Inductive findtype : exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | findtype_int : forall i5,
     findtype (e_lit i5) t_int
 | findtype_arrow : forall (e:exp),
     lc_exp (e_abs e) ->
     findtype  (e_abs e) (t_arrow t_top t_bot)
 | findtype_null :
     findtype e_null t_unit
 | find_type_new : forall P,
     findtype (e_new P) (t_prim P).

Inductive typing (PG:envp) : env -> exp -> typ -> Prop :=
 | typ_lit : forall (G:env) i5,
      ok  G  ->
      okenvp PG ->
     typing PG G (e_lit i5) t_int
 | typ_null : forall G,
      ok G ->
      okenvp PG ->
      typing PG G e_null t_unit
 | typ_var : forall (G:env) (x:var) (A:typ),
      ok  G  ->
      okenvp PG ->
      wft PG A ->
      binds  x A G  ->
     typing PG G (e_var_f x) A
 | typ_app : forall (G:env) (e1 e2:exp) (B A:typ),
     okenvp PG -> wft PG A -> wft PG B ->
     typing PG G e1 (t_arrow A B) ->
     typing PG G e2 A ->
     typing PG G (e_app e1 e2) B
 | typ_sub : forall (G:env) (e:exp) (A B:typ),
     typing PG G e B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG B A ->
     typing PG G e A
 | typ_abs : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (e:exp) (A B:typ),
      okenvp PG -> wft PG A -> wft PG B ->
      ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> typing PG (G & x ~: A )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x) ) B )  ->
     typing PG G (e_abs e) (t_arrow A B)
 | typ_typeof : forall (L:vars) (G:env) (e:exp) (A:typ) (e1:exp) (B:typ) (e2:exp) (C:typ),
     typing PG G e (t_union A B) ->
     ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> typing PG  (G & x ~: A )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e1 (e_var_f x) ) C ) ->
     ( forall x , x \notin  L  -> typing PG  (G & x ~: B )   ( open_exp_wrt_exp e2 (e_var_f x) ) C ) ->
     PG ||- A *s B ->
     typing PG G (e_typeof e A e1 B e2) C
 | typ_prim : forall i G,
    ok G ->
    okenvp PG -> wft PG (t_prim i) ->
     typing PG G (e_new i) (t_prim i).

Reserved Notation "PG ||- e --> e'" (at level 80).

Inductive step (PG:envp) : exp -> exp -> Prop :=
 | step_appl : forall (e1 e2 e1':exp),
     lc_exp e2 ->
     PG ||- e1 --> e1' ->
     PG ||- (e_app e1 e2) --> (e_app e1' e2)
 | step_appr : forall (v e e':exp),
     value v ->
     PG ||- e --> e' ->
     PG ||- (e_app v e) --> (e_app v e')
 | step_beta : forall (e:exp) (v:exp),
     lc_exp (e_abs e) ->
     value v ->
     PG ||- e_app  (e_abs e) v --> (open_exp_wrt_exp e v)
 | step_typeof : forall (e:exp) (A:typ) (e1:exp) (B:typ) (e2 e':exp),
     lc_exp (e_typeof e A e1 B e2) ->
     PG ||- e --> e' ->
     PG ||- (e_typeof e A e1 B e2) --> (e_typeof e' A e1 B e2)
 | step_typeofl : forall (v:exp) (A:typ) (e1:exp) (B:typ) (e2:exp) (C:typ),
     lc_exp (e_typeof v A e1 B e2) ->
     value v ->
     findtype v C ->
     declarative_subtyping PG C A ->
     PG ||- (e_typeof v A e1 B e2) -->  (open_exp_wrt_exp e1 v)
 | step_typeofr : forall (v:exp) (A:typ) (e1:exp) (B:typ) (e2:exp) (C:typ),
    lc_exp (e_typeof v A e1 B e2) ->
     value v ->
     findtype v C ->
     declarative_subtyping PG C B ->
     PG ||- (e_typeof v A e1 B e2) -->  (open_exp_wrt_exp  e2 v )
where "PG ||- e --> e'" := (step PG e e') : env_scope.

Require Import Program.Equality.

Theorem preservation : forall PG E e e' T,
  typing PG E e T ->
  PG ||- e --> e' ->
  typing PG E e' T.

Theorem progress : forall PG e T,
    typing PG empty e T -> (value e) \/ (exists e', PG ||- e --> e').

End Typing_part.

Require Import Metalib.Metatheory.

Require Import Lia.

Inductive typ : Set :=
 | t_int : typ
 | t_top : typ
 | t_bot : typ
 | t_arrow : typ -> typ -> typ
 | t_union : typ -> typ -> typ
 | t_and : typ -> typ -> typ
 | t_unit : typ
 | t_prim (n:var).

Definition envp : Set := list ( atom * typ ).

Inductive wft (PG:envp) : typ -> Prop :=
  | wft_top :
      wft PG t_top
  | wft_bot :
      wft PG t_bot
  | wft_int :
      wft PG t_int
  | wft_arrow : forall A B,
      wft PG A ->
      wft PG B ->
      wft PG (t_arrow A B)
  | wft_or : forall A B,
      wft PG A ->
      wft PG B ->
      wft PG (t_union A B)
  | wft_and : forall A B,
      wft PG A ->
      wft PG B ->
      wft PG (t_and A B)
  | wft_unit :
      wft PG t_unit
  | wft_prim : forall i A,
      binds i A PG ->
      wft PG (t_prim i).

Inductive okenvp : envp -> Prop :=
  | okenvp_empty :
      okenvp nil
  | okenvp_cons : forall (PG:envp) (i:var),
      okenvp PG ->
      i `notin` (dom PG) ->
      okenvp ((i, t_top) :: PG)
  | okenvp_sub : forall (PG:envp) (i j:var),
      okenvp PG ->
      wft PG (t_prim j) ->
      i `notin` (dom PG) ->
      okenvp ((i, (t_prim j)) :: PG).

Inductive declarative_subtyping (PG: envp) : typ -> typ -> Prop :=
 | DS_refl : forall (A:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A ->
     declarative_subtyping PG A A
 | DS_trans : forall (A C B:typ),
     declarative_subtyping PG A B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG B C ->
     declarative_subtyping PG A C
 | DS_top : forall (A:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A ->
     declarative_subtyping PG A t_top
 | DS_bot : forall (A:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A ->
     declarative_subtyping PG t_bot A
 | DS_arrow : forall (A C B D:typ),
     declarative_subtyping PG B A ->
     declarative_subtyping PG C D ->
     declarative_subtyping PG (t_arrow A C) (t_arrow B D)
 | DS_and : forall (A B C:typ),
     declarative_subtyping PG A B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG A C ->
     declarative_subtyping PG A (t_and B C)
 | DS_andl : forall (A B:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A -> wft PG B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG (t_and A B) A
 | DS_andr : forall (A B:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A -> wft PG B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG (t_and A B) B
 | DS_or : forall (A B C:typ),
     declarative_subtyping PG A C ->
     declarative_subtyping PG B C ->
     declarative_subtyping PG (t_union A B) C
 | DS_orl : forall (A B:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A -> wft PG B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG A (t_union A B)
 | DS_orr : forall (B A:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A -> wft PG B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG B (t_union A B)
 | DS_distArr : forall (A B1 B2:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A -> wft PG B1 -> wft PG B2 ->
     declarative_subtyping PG (t_and  (t_arrow A B1)   (t_arrow A B2) ) (t_arrow A (t_and B1 B2))
| DS_distArrU : forall (A1 B A2:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A1 -> wft PG A2 -> wft PG B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG (t_and  (t_arrow A1 B)   (t_arrow A2 B) ) (t_arrow (t_union A1 A2) B)
 | DS_distOr : forall (A1 B A2:typ),
     okenvp PG ->
     wft PG A1 -> wft PG A2 -> wft PG B ->
     declarative_subtyping PG (t_and  (t_union A1 B)   (t_union A2 B) ) (t_union  (t_and A1 A2)  B)
 | DS_prim : forall i A,
     okenvp PG ->
     binds i A PG ->
     declarative_subtyping PG (t_prim i) A.

```
  | t_prim j => i = j \/ binds i (t_prim j) PG

```

```
Lemma typing_inv_lit : forall PG G i U,
  typing PG G (e_lit i) U -> ok G /\ okenvp PG /\ declarative_subtyping PG t_int U.
Proof.
  intros PG G i U H. dependent induction H.
  - split; [auto|]. split; [auto|]. apply DS_refl; [auto|apply wft_int].
  - destruct (IHtyping i eq_refl) as [Hok [Hokp Hsub]].
    split; [auto|]. split; [auto|]. eapply DS_trans; eauto.

Lemma typing_inv_null : forall PG G U,
  typing PG G e_null U -> ok G /\ okenvp PG /\ declarative_subtyping PG t_unit U.
Proof.
  intros PG G U H. dependent induction H.
  - split; [auto|]. split; [auto|]. apply DS_refl; [auto|apply wft_unit].
  - destruct IHtyping as [Hok [Hokp Hsub]].
    split; [auto|]. split; [auto|]. eapply DS_trans; eauto.

  typing PG G (e_new i) U -> ok G /\ okenvp PG /\ wft PG (t_prim i) /\ declarative_subtyping PG (t_prim i) U.

  intros PG G i U H. dependent induction H.
  - repeat split; auto. apply DS_refl; auto.
  - destruct (IHtyping i eq_refl) as [Hok [Hokp [Hw Hsub]]].
    repeat split; auto. eapply DS_trans; eauto.
Qed.

  exists A B, typing PG G e1 (t_arrow A B) /\ typing PG G e2 A /\ declarative_subtyping PG B U.

  - exists A, B. repeat split; auto. apply DS_refl; auto.
  - destruct (IHtyping e1 e2 eq_refl) as [A' [B' [Ht1 [Ht2 Hsub]]]].
    exists A', B'. repeat split; auto. eapply DS_trans; eauto.
Qed.

  exists L A B, okenvp PG /\ wft PG A /\ wft PG B /\
    (forall x, x \notin L -> typing PG (G & x ~: A) (open_exp_wrt_exp e (e_var_f x)) B) /\
```

```
Lemma wft_arrow_inv : forall PG A B, wft PG (t_arrow A B) -> wft PG A /\ wft PG B.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma wft_union_inv : forall PG A B, wft PG (t_union A B) -> wft PG A /\ wft PG B.

Lemma wft_and_inv : forall PG A B, wft PG (t_and A B) -> wft PG A /\ wft PG B.
Proof. intros. inversion H. auto. Qed.
Lemma wft_prim_inv : forall PG i, wft PG (t_prim i) -> exists A, binds i A PG.
Proof. intros. inversion H. subst. eauto. Qed.

Lemma okenvp_binds_shape : forall PG (x:var) (A:typ),
  okenvp PG -> binds x A PG -> A = t_top \/ (exists j, A = t_prim j).

  - destruct (binds_push_inv Hb) as [[Heq1 Heq2] | [Hneq Hb']].
    + right. subst. exists j. reflexivity.
    + apply IH. auto.
Qed.

Lemma okenvp_binds_wft : forall PG (x:var) (A:typ),
  okenvp PG -> binds x A PG -> wft PG A.
Proof.
  intros PG x A Hok. induction Hok as [| PG i Hok IH Hni | PG i j Hok IH Hwft Hni]; intros Hb.
  - exfalso. apply (binds_empty_inv Hb).
  - destruct (binds_push_inv Hb) as [[Heq1 Heq2] | [Hneq Hb']].

  - destruct (binds_push_inv Hb) as [[Heq1 Heq2] | [Hneq Hb']].
    + subst. apply wft_prim. auto.
    + apply IH. auto.
Qed.

Lemma typing_okenvp : forall PG G e T, typing PG G e T -> okenvp PG.
```

```
Lemma arrow_union_inv : forall PG A' B' A B,
  okenvp PG -> wft PG (t_arrow A' B') ->
  declarative_subtyping PG (t_arrow A' B') (t_union A B) ->
  declarative_subtyping PG (t_arrow A' B') A \/ declarative_subtyping PG (t_arrow A' B') B.
Proof.
  intros PG A' B' A B Hok Hw Hsub.
  assert (Ha : atomicT (t_arrow A' B')) by (right; right; right; exists A', B'; reflexivity).
  pose proof (isSup_complete PG (t_arrow A' B') (t_union A B) Hsub Ha) as Hs.
  simpl in Hs. destruct Hs as [[H1 [HW1 HW2]] | [H2 [HW1 HW2]]].
  - left. eapply isSup_sound; eauto.
  - right. eapply isSup_sound; eauto.

Lemma arrow_arrow_inv : forall PG A' B' A B,
  declarative_subtyping PG (t_arrow A' B') (t_arrow A B) ->
  declarative_subtyping PG A A' /\ declarative_subtyping PG B' B.
Proof.
  intros PG A' B' A B Hsub.
  assert (Ha : atomicT (t_arrow A' B')) by (right; right; right; exists A', B'; reflexivity).
  pose proof (isSup_complete PG (t_arrow A' B') (t_arrow A B) Hsub Ha) as Hs.
  simpl in Hs. exact Hs.

  declarative_subtyping PG (t_arrow A' B') A.

  assert (Hand : declarative_subtyping PG D (t_and A B)) by (apply DS_and; auto).
  exact (Hdisj D (o_arrow _ _) Hand).
```

Lemma value_findtype : forall v, value v -> exists C, findtype v C.
Proof.
  intros v Hv. destruct Hv as [i | e0 Hlc | | P].
  - exists t_int. apply findtype_int.
  - exists (t_arrow t_top t_bot). apply findtype_arrow; auto.

Lemma progress_gen : forall PG G e T,
  typing PG G e T -> G = empty -> value e \/ (exists e', step PG e e').
Proof.
  intros PG G e T H.
  induction H as [ G i Hok Hokp
                 | G Hok Hokp
                 | G x A Hok Hokp Hwft Hb
                 | G e1 e2 B A Hokp HwftA HwftB Ht1 IH1 Ht2 IH2
                 | G e A B Ht IHt Hsub
                 | L G e A B Hokp HwftA HwftB Hbody IHbody
                 | L G e A e1 B e2 C Ht IHt Hb1 IHb1 Hb2 IHb2 Hdisj
                 | i G Hok Hokp Hwft ]; intros HG.

  - left. apply val_null.
  - subst G. exfalso. eapply binds_empty_inv; eauto.

      subst e1.

        -- exact Hval1.

## What was proved

**`preservation`** — by induction on the typing derivation, with inversion on the single step:

- **app**: handles `step_appl`, `step_appr`, and `step_beta`. Beta needs inversion of the typing of the abstraction, arrow-subtyping inversion (`arrow_arrow_inv`), and a general substitution lemma.
- **typeof**: handles `step_typeof`, `step_typeofl`, `step_typeofr`. The two switch rules are the crux: given the scrutinee's typing at `A ∪ B` and `findtype v C` with `C <: A` (resp. `B`), one shows `v : A` (resp. `v : B`), then substitutes `v` into the selected branch.
- value/abs/prim cases are vacuous (values don't step).

**`progress`** — by induction on typing, generalized to an arbitrary context with a `G = empty` equation (so subderivations can be used). Uses canonical-form facts (`value_arrow_abs`, `value_findtype`) and the branch-selection lemma to build the step for type switches.

## Key supporting development added inside `Typing_part`

- Locally-closed/opening infrastructure (`lc_at`, `lc_exp_open_rec`, `open_subst_comm'`, `subst_open_ident`).
- Well-formedness inversion/monotonicity, environment-insertion lemmas, `typing_okenvp`, `typing_lc`.
- Value typing inversion (`typing_inv_lit/null/new/abs`).
- Context weakening (middle-insertion form) and a general substitution lemma for typing.
- The decisive subtyping machinery: a positive-supertype predicate `isSup` (and `isSupP` for primitive types) with transitivity, soundness and completeness; from it, arrow inversion and the fact that `S <: A ∪ B` for a concrete `S` implies `S <: A` or `S <: B`.
- The disjointness argument: if `arrow A' B' <: A ∪ B`, `arrow ⊤ ⊥ <: A`, and `A`, `B` are disjoint, then `arrow A' B' <: A` (via a common lower bound of two arrow types contradicting `DisjSpec`).
- `findtype` least-type and branch-selection lemmas; typing a value at the selected branch (`value_type_left/right`).

- Supplied definitions, target statements, and hypotheses are unchanged; only `Task.v` was edited (scratch files used during development were removed).
